cause: Concurrent P1/P3 launcher passed reports path relative to repository. Provider bytes were decoded, validated, hashed and saved; relative_to(absolute ROOT) then raised local ValueError before cost/path fields were appended.
affected_process: Current P1/P3 process uses its originally loaded module for20calls perarm; no reload and no provider retry.
fix_for_future_processes: Resolve image path absolute before serialization. P2 runner will use corrected function and absolute reportspath.
note: Local ValueError is not a provider failure. Reliability rule still uses HTTP200 valid decoded image>10240bytes. All original local-error fields remain in raw receipts.
